reasons.specificity: It closely tracks the article’s distinctive progression from Benjamin through Simmel, Marx, Schumpeter, the myth cycle, and the conditional contemporary diagnosis.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly all quotations occur verbatim and support the claimed sequence, mediation, temporal cycle, and closure, though F10’s first anchor is visibly truncated.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully distinguishes argumentative sequence from narrated history, mediated class experience from direct testimony, and conceptual closure from unresolved historical prognosis.
reasons.coherence: The account is largely consistent, but it calls the money-definition move the “first decisive turn” and Marx’s rehabilitation the “most consequential internal reversal” without clearly ranking either as the requested central turn.
reasons.usefulness: The two main tables are accurate and practical, but the extensive ledger, scope review, and metadata make the artifact far longer and less desk-ready than the requested one-page account.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Claims are generally bounded and source-faithful, with appropriate cautions that the myth cycle is a model and the ending is conditional rather than accomplished.

score.one_line: A highly source-specific and well-anchored reading whose chief weakness is failure to deliver the requested concise one-page format and to designate one unambiguous central turn.
